review_kind: Independent read-only source/test/result review; no simulation or build rerun

reset_state_review.pointer_and_remote_pointer_state: All binary/Gray pointers, 2-stage sync pointers and converted remote pointers asynchronously clear on local reset; release must remain supplied by original nav_rst_sync synchronizers.
reset_state_review.output_FWFT: Only pend/cnt asynchronously clear. b0/b1 payload remain posedge-only/no data reset; the split cases preserve no-reset count and payload updates.
reset_state_review.reset_gates: wr and s_ready gated by~wrst; private ram_rd/m_valid gated by~rst; hence no logical RAM write/read or valid handshake during asserted local reset.
reset_state_review.supported_contract: Common reset that reaches both endpoints before reopening. Independently asserted single-side reset is not supported or proved.

coverage_meanings.port_cycle_checks60400: Sum of phase1 non-reset write-clock ready/free checks and read-clock valid/data checks. Not60400 transactions, reset scenarios or distinct clock alignments.
coverage_meanings.normal_writes12243_reads12218: Cumulative phase1 transfers;25 pending words are intentionally dropped at common resets. Separate phase3 fresh recovery adds24 words outside these counters.
coverage_meanings.full_capacity_words2050: 2048-word RAM plus unchanged2-word FWFT output/in-flight capacity; not a RAM depth increase.
coverage_meanings.continuous_read_streak2051: Maximum measured consecutive normal-phase read handshakes over the whole test; not a universal throughput guarantee.
coverage_meanings.wrap_writes10000: Finite faster-producer/backpressure/valid-gap run spanning2 full12-bit pointer wraps; only DW10/AW11 exercised.
coverage_meanings.reset_checks451: Sum of asserted-reset reader/writer clock-edge checks, not451 distinct reset events.
coverage_meanings.reset_write_attempts28: 28 write-clock observations with s_valid high during local reset, checking wr/ready0; retained mem[0] checked per selected FWFT shape, not a sweep of every RAM address.
coverage_meanings.middle_reset_phases4: Selected FWFT(cnt,pend)=(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0), with both clocks running; does not cover every combined clock-stop/nonempty-buffer case.

remaining_unknowns: No mapped primitive/reset/CE/INIT/RAM collision-mode or actual RAM/DSP/fanout measurement for this candidate.
No recovery/removal, reset routing, metastability/MTBF, physical CDC delay or full state-space FIFO proof.
Finite clock ratios/alignments and DW10/AW11 only; simultaneous clock stops, very short reset pulses and all stop/nonempty combinations are not separately proved.
Unilateral reset/restart needs a separate common flush or explicit epoch/ready coordination; no such support is implied.

FIFO fixes do not reset the existing rgmii RX FSM, prove external SOF, or prevent admission of a post-reset partial frame tail. End-to-end frame validation, timestamp freshness and vehicle effects remain unverified.
